import random, subprocess, math

def run_guess(n):
    res=subprocess.run(['./guess.py', str(n)],capture_output=True,text=True)
    return res.stdout.strip()

def algo(target):
    candidates=list(range(1,1025))
    probs={c:1/1024 for c in candidates}
    for q in range(15):
        if len(candidates)==1:
            return candidates[0]
        median=candidates[len(candidates)//2]
        out=run_guess(median)
        new_probs={}
        for c in candidates:
            true_resp='equals' if c==median else ('higher' if c>median else 'lower')
            if out=='equals':
                weight=1 if c==median else 0
            else:
                prob = 0.7 if out==true_resp else 0.3
                weight=prob
            new_probs[c]=probs[c]*weight
        total=sum(new_probs.values())
        if total==0:
            # fallback random select
            return random.choice(candidates)
        probs={c:p/total for c,p in new_probs.items()}
        candidates=[c for c in candidates if probs[c]>1e-12]
    # after 15, choose max prob
    return max(probs, key=probs.get)

# test many runs
import os, sys
# compile guess.py? assuming present
cnt=0
for _ in range(100):
    target=random.randint(1,1024)
    res=algo(target)
    if res==target:
        cnt+=1
print('success',cnt)
PY"]}<|call|>
